title: Job queue with visibility timeout and permanent ack
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag re-delivery at exactly the timeout instant or FIFO order on redelivery. Both are stated: a job is visible when visible_at <= now, and scanning in enqueue order keeps the oldest job first even after a timeout.
